rationale: The Turoyo names ʕeḏo rabo and describes coloring boiled eggs. In this same batch ṣym.I.t.infectum-wa.1 quotes u=ʕeḏo=rabo with the supplied JL 5.10.1 translation Osterfest and the fifty-day fast. Christmas contradicts that identification.

summary: Move the future egg-coloring example to Infectum
before: ʕeḏo rabo, annaqqa gәd maṣwʕina beʕe, šәlqina beʕe w maswʕinanne šәklat,
after: ʕeḏo rabo, annaqqa gәd maṣwʕina beʕe, šәlqina beʕe w maswʕinanne šәklat,
rationale: gәd maṣwʕina is a future construction with first-person plural Infectum, and the translation says we color eggs. It is not the stem III Preterit in -le given in maṣwaʕle. File it under III Infectum.
The verb meaning to dye is färben. The unaccented farben is an inherited typo, also present in the supplied corpus translation; the Turoyo ṣoʕət and the stem gloss färben establish the intended word.
